headline: Executive order directs the creation of labor-management forums in federal agencies to improve how government services are delivered.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up forums where federal agency managers and representatives of federal employees, such as their unions, meet to work together. The stated goal is to improve how the government delivers services to the public. No summary was provided, so details on how the forums are set up and run are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would gain forums where their representatives meet with agency managers to discuss how work is done.
They would take part in these forums with employee representatives.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal government services
who_it_affects.how: The forums are meant to improve how those services are delivered.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 9, 2009; no separate effective date is given in the source material.
